reason: Radix Dialog.Root and Dialog.Portal render no element and closed Overlay/Content are not mounted; a server-rendered Stimulus port needs one controller host (Trigger cannot host it: zero, one or several triggers, or controlled open) and somewhere to ship the closed markup. Neither element carries a data-slot, classes or layout (display: contents / template), so the compared DOM is unchanged. Portal container is a DOM node in React and cannot be passed from Ruby.
api: Dialog renders one <div style="display: contents" data-controller="shadcn--dialog"> host with no data-slot, classes or other data attributes besides controller wiring
closed Portal children (Overlay, Content) are server-rendered inside a <template> in the host and mounted into document.body on open
Dialog::Portal container: is a CSS selector string instead of a DOM element
